name: Duke's Donuts
source:
You are a private investigator searching for clues to find a missing person. So far they have led you to the abandoned Duke's Donuts location she was last seen. 

[from [url=https://axxisproductions.itch.io/dukes-donuts]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名私家侦探，正在寻找线索以寻找失踪者。到目前为止，他们已经带你到了她最后一次出现的废弃的杜克甜甜圈地点。

[来自[url=https://axxisproductions.itch.io/dukes-donuts]itch.io[/url]]
